sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:111606
Court No. - 84
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 5161 of 2023

Applicant :- Suman Gautam
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Kailash Singh Kushwaha,Ramesh Chandra Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. This application has been moved on behalf of the applicant Suman Gautam seeking anticipatory
bail in Case Crime No.23 of 2014, under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B Ipc, Police Station-
Civil Lines, District Meerut.

3.  It is alleged in the FIR that the accused applicant at the relevant time was working as District Minority Welfare Officer, Meerut and towards distribution of scholarship Rs.17 lacs were sanctioned to be distributed as scholarship to several Schools and Madarsas but however the said amount was not distributed and forged account numbers were sent to the Government.
The bank account numbers were also manipulated and accordingly the Principal and Managers of the concerned schools did not distribute it amongst the students eligible for the scholarship.

It is alleged that as District Minority Welfare Officer, the present accused applicant was duty bound to send a proper,
genuine and accurate report to the government but she in a criminal conspiracy with other accused persons, caused a huge loss of public money to the government.

Suman Gautam vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156269627/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It has been argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has apprehension of his arrest in the above-mentioned case, whereas there is no credible evidence against him.
Allegations levelled against the applicant are false.

It is further submitted that the accused applicant had no role in the commission of the alleged crime, the lists of the students along with the bank account numbers were sent by the principles/ managers of the concerned schools and the present accused applicant is only the forwarding authority.

It is further submitted that in Cr.
Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 CR.P.C. No. - 7919 of 2020 the anticipatory bail was granted by this Court to the accused applicant vide order dated 18.01.2023 and now the charge sheet has been submitted and during course of investigation the accused has accorded her full cooperation to the I.O. of the case.
The investigation of the case has been completed and charge-sheet has been filed.
It is lastly submitted that in case applicant is granted anticipatory bail, she shall not misuse the liberty of bail and would obey all conditions of bail.

5. Learned A.G.A on the other hand opposes the anticipatory bail application and it has been vehemently argued that more than 35 cases of similar nature have been lodged against the accused applicant which have been described in the supplementary affidavit filed today.

It is further submitted that the accused applicant being District Minority Officer was fully responsible to send an accurate and genuine data to the government and by submission of the charge sheet it is sufficiently shown that ample evidence has been collected against the accused applicant in this case.
6.
In this matter, it reveals that after completion of investigation, charge sheet has been submitted and cognizance has also been taken by the Court concerned.

In Sushila Aggarwal and others vs.
State (NCT of Delhi) and another, (2020) 5 SCC 1, the Hon'ble Apex Court has settled the controversy finally by holding the anticipatory bail need not be of limited duration invariably.

entities.text:
Sushila Aggarwal and others vs.
State (NCT of Delhi) and another, (2020) 5 SCC 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In appropriate case, it can continue upto conclusion of trial.
7. It has been further held therein that anticipatory bail granted can, depending on the conduct and behavior of the accused, continue after filing of the charge sheet till end of trial.

8. It has been further held by the Hon'ble Apex Court that while considering an application for grant of anticipatory bail, the court has to consider the nature of the offence, the role of the person, the likelihood of his influencing the course of investigation, or tampering with evidence including intimidating witnesses, llikelihood of fleeing justice, such as leaving the country, etc.

It has further been held that Courts ought to be generally guided by considerations such as the nature and gravity of the offences, the role attributed to the applicant, and the facts of the case, while considering whether to grant anticipatory bail, or refuse it.
Whether to grant or not is a matter of discretion.
9. In view of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court, I deem it not a fit case to grant anticipatory bail to the present applicant.
Prayer made in the application is refused.
10. The anticipatory bail application is rejected.

11. However, it is observed that the bail application of the applicant, if moved, shall be considered and decided by the Court concerned in terms of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in Suman Gautam vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156269627/
